question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Maintanance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Maintanance" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Maintenance".**
 
• **"Maintenance"** means the process of preserving something or keeping it in a particular condition. (रखरखाव)
 
 
• **Example: **The maintenance of the garden requires regular watering and pruning.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Important** (महत्वपूर्ण): Of great significance or value.

 
 
• **Example:** It is important to stay hydrated during the summer.
 
 
 
• **Friend** (मित्र): A person with whom one has a bond of mutual affection.
 
 
• **Example:** She is my best friend and has always supported me.
 
 
 
• **Rhythm** (ताल): A strong, regular, repeated pattern of movement or sound.
 
 
• **Example:** The rhythm of the song made everyone want to dance.
